product_title: Handcrafted Lotus and Rose Decorative Tealight Runner
product_description: Elevate your festive table decor with this beautifully handcrafted tealight runner, featuring elegant golden detailing, intricate mirror-work patterns, vibrant magenta roses, and decorative pink lotus motifs. Designed with three golden tealight holders and delicate pearl embellishments, this statement piece brings traditional Indian artistry and luxurious charm to your home. Perfect for Diwali celebrations, festive dining tables, pooja arrangements, wedding decor, and special occasions, it creates an elegant setting filled with warmth and festive beauty.
product_care_suggestion: Gently dust with a soft, dry cloth or a soft-bristled brush.
Avoid water, excessive moisture, and harsh cleaning chemicals to protect the fabric and embellishments.
Handle the mirror work, pearls, and floral decorations carefully to prevent damage.
Keep artificial flowers away from direct heat and open flames.
Keep away from prolonged direct sunlight to preserve the vibrant colours and golden finish.
Store in a dry place in a protective box or fabric bag when not in use.
